newsitem.title: UK: Clarke sees PSBR at 26.5 billion stg in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Clarke sees PSBR at 26.5 billion stg in 1996/97.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said in his budget speech that he expected the UK's public sector borrowing requirement (budget deficit) to be 26.5 billion stg in 1996/97 and 19.0 billion in 1997/8.

"I expect the Public Sector Borrowing Requirement to be 26.5 billion stg this year. That will mean it has halved as a share of GDP over the past three years," he said in a speech to parliament on the 1997/98 budget.
"I expect it to come down to 19.0 billion stg next year and to be broadly in balance by 1999-2000," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7708
